description: Start a competitive pilot round on one of your OpenTrain WorkProjects: 2-10 participants each label the IDENTICAL sample (same tasks, same gold, same config — hard-enforced via an immutable batch), scored by the same quality engine. Unpaid testing round by default; participants already hired on the linked job keep their contract. Sample = explicit taskIds or the first sampleSize unlabeled tasks. Find participants with opentrain_search_talent. Requires open-label:write scope.

blind.description: Mask participant identities from the buyer until the round is decided.

name.description: Round name shown to the buyer.

participantUserIds.description: 2-10 talent user ids (find them via opentrain_search_talent).

sampleSize.description: Auto-pick N tasks, gold-aware: gold tasks fill up to half the sample (default 20).

taskIds.description: Explicit sample task ids; mutually exclusive with sampleSize.

name: opentrain_create_pilot_round
